01 / Campaign overviewThe idea

New York,
reimagined
through scent.

An ode to the city’s quieter moments.

Les Essences de New York is a conceptual Spring 2027 limited-edition collection created for Diptyque Paris. From magnolia blossoms along brownstone streets to fig leaves in hidden gardens, fresh bergamot in the morning, and woody notes after rain, the collection captures New York through the senses rather than its familiar skyline alone.

The campaign extends across scented candles, perfume, body care, and home fragrance, offering a connected story of place and memory. French-inspired engraving, botanical details, nostalgic paper textures, and refined editorial typography bring a softer, more intimate perspective to the city.

The moodboard.

03 / Visual identityColor story

A city in
soft color.

An understated palette, rooted in place.

Warm ivory recalls limestone buildings and vintage paper; park sage and Hudson blue evoke the city’s pockets of greenery and cool skies. Brownstone and oxblood add warmth and depth, while midnight ink anchors the illustrated identity.

Ivory and ink should dominate the system. The remaining tones act as restrained accents, giving different fragrance stories a distinct mood while keeping the overall campaign coherent.

60% base25% ink15% accents
04 / Visual identityTypography system

An editorial
point of view.

Four complementary typefaces express both Diptyque’s French heritage and the contemporary elegance of New York. The hierarchy remains simple: expressive display type, balanced by clear supporting text.

01 / Cormorant GaramondPrimary display
Les Essences

Romantic, graceful serif for campaign titles, poetic headlines, and the hero section.

02 / Bodoni ModaEditorial accent
NEW YORK

High-contrast fashion serif for scent names, packaging details, and select statements.

03 / Josefin SansLabels / navigation
SPRING 2027

Architectural and slightly vintage sans-serif for dates, section labels, and small uppercase text.

04 / DM SansBody / digital
Scent is memory.

Accessible, contemporary sans-serif for descriptions, campaign interfaces, and digital formats.

05 / Campaign identityThe emblem

A mark of
the city.

The campaign emblem is inspired by the ornate quality of historical Diptyque labels. A bold N sits within a double-bordered oval, framed by botanical engraving and recognizable New York architecture.

  • The letter NA typographic anchor for New York and the collection’s identity.
  • Magnolia & figNatural fragrance ingredients and the quiet beauty hidden within the city.
  • Skyline & brownstoneA meeting of iconic landmarks and intimate neighborhood details.
  • Ink illustrationA timeless, crafted expression designed for labels, packaging, and campaign graphics.

06 / ApplicationCollection architecture

One city.
Many rituals.

The campaign system can extend across several fragrance formats, each drawing from the same visual language of botanical engraving, muted colors, and NYC storytelling.

01 / HOME

Scented candles

Neighborhood-inspired scent stories, from spring blossoms to warm, woody interiors.

02 / FRAGRANCE

Perfumes

Wearable impressions of New York, built around floral, green, and aromatic notes.

03 / RITUAL

Body care

Hand and body products that bring the scent of the collection into everyday moments.

04 / INTERIOR

Home fragrance

Room sprays and diffusers that evoke a place, an atmosphere, or a memory.
